$schema_note: Reference circuits for HFKit engine feasibility spike. Distances are great-circle (haversine), km. lat/lon in decimal degrees WGS84 (display convention per docs/08-domain-model.md); dvoacap itself wants radians via GeoPoint.from_degrees().

circuits.name: Washington DC -> New York City
circuits.rationale: ~300 km NVIS-range path, the regime relevant to emergency/ARES-style regional comms. Should favor low-to-mid frequencies and steep (near-vertical) takeoff angles.

circuits.name: Singapore -> Kuala Lumpur
circuits.rationale: Short (~300 km) path near the geomagnetic equator, to see whether equatorial ionospheric behavior (higher foF2, equatorial anomaly) changes short-path sanity results vs. the mid-latitude short path.

circuits.name: Atlanta -> Boston
circuits.rationale: ~1500 km single/double-hop mid-latitude path, the classic 'regional net' distance.

circuits.name: Sydney -> Auckland
circuits.rationale: ~2150 km mid-range path entirely in the Southern Hemisphere, to check for hemisphere-flip bugs (e.g. season/local-time handling done backwards below the equator).

circuits.name: New York City -> London
circuits.rationale: Classic ~5600 km transatlantic DX path, well inside VOACAP's validated short-path regime (<7000 km). This is the 'should just work' reference circuit and the one used for the representative plots.

circuits.name: Anchorage -> Reykjavik
circuits.rationale: ~5400 km path with both endpoints at high geomagnetic latitude, to stress the auroral/geomagnetic-latitude loss adjustment terms independent of raw path length.

circuits.name: Singapore -> Nairobi
circuits.rationale: ~7450 km path that stays close to the geomagnetic equator along its whole length, sitting right at the engine's internal short/long-path model boundary (RAD_7000_KM).

circuits.name: Seattle -> Tokyo
circuits.rationale: ~7700 km great-circle path that arcs up to ~60N, the highest-latitude long path in this set, exercising the geomagnetic model away from the equator over a long distance.

circuits.name: Los Angeles -> Sydney
circuits.rationale: ~12000 km path, past the 10000 km point where real VOACAP switches fully to its long-path model. dvoacap's long-path model is a stub (see FINDINGS.md) so this circuit is expected to silently reuse the short-path model far outside its design envelope -- a key thing to check for plausibility.

circuits.name: New York City -> Perth
circuits.rationale: ~18700 km, close to antipodal (max possible great-circle distance is ~20015 km). Worst-case stress test of the short-path-only model far past its 10000 km validity limit.
